eyebrow: Creating a role in Tabular Editor
caption: Power BI Desktop has no built-in OLS editor. A role gets created the same way any model object does — right-click Roles, Create.
Every table and column exposes one Object Level Security value per role: Default, Read, or None.
Before any change, every role typically starts at Default for every object — nothing is hidden until someone sets it to None.

steps.label: NONE MEANS AN ERROR
steps.sub: not a blank — any visual or measure referencing it fails
